output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(a); w=len(a[0])
    # marker row: nonzero colors other than the template, in upper portion
    mr=None; marks=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(a):
        xs=[(j,v) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v]
        if xs and i < h//2:
            mr=i; marks=[v for j,v in xs]; break
    # locate color-2 template below
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if a[i][j]==2 and (mr is None or i>mr)]
    if not pts:return a
    r0=min(i for i,j in pts); r1=max(i for i,j in pts); c0=min(j for i,j in pts); c1=max(j for i,j in pts)
    shape=[(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pts]
    bw=c1-c0+1; step=bw+1
    n=len(marks)
    # choose direction that fits all copies
    if c0+(n-1)*step+bw<=w:
        starts=[c0+k*step for k in range(n)]
    else:
        starts=[c0-(n-1-k)*step for k in range(n)]
    for col,s in zip(marks,starts):
        for dr,dc in shape:
            rr=r0+dr; cc=s+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:a[rr][cc]=col
    return a"}
